formulas.ascii: remove mode: a patch with n pixels keeps its label when n >= minimumPixels and otherwise becomes 0 (background), so patchTargets[p-1] = p or 0 and every pixel takes patchTargets[label-1]; background stays 0; merge mode instead gives a small patch the label of its largest adjacent patch that is not small (lowest label on ties; none leaves it removed). sievedCount counts non-empty patches with n < minimumPixels; unconverged labels fill every output word with the unresolved sentinel.
